import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

daemon = Path("src/do_again/service/daemon.py")
tests = Path("tests/test_daemon.py")

text = daemon.read_text()
old = '''        try:
            notify_receipt(repo, receipt)
        except BrowserError as exc:
            blocked += 1
            last_error = str(exc)
            continue
'''
new = '''        try:
            notify_receipt(repo, receipt)
        except BrowserError as exc:
            if "ChatGPT is still generating; retry delivery later" not in str(exc):
                raise
            blocked += 1
            last_error = str(exc)
            continue
'''
if old not in text:
    raise SystemExit("resilience catch block not found")
daemon.write_text(text.replace(old, new, 1))

t = tests.read_text()

anchor = '''    def test_successful_delivery_removes_outbox_item(self) -> None:
'''
if anchor not in t:
    raise SystemExit("test anchor not found")

new_test = '''    def test_nontransient_browser_error_still_aborts_drain(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            state_dir = Path(tmp) / "state"
            path = _queue_receipt(state_dir, {"request_id": "hard", "state": "succeeded"})
            repo = Path(tmp) / "repo"
            repo.mkdir()

            with (
                patch("do_again.service.daemon.activate_project"),
                patch("do_again.service.daemon.ensure_browser_running"),
                patch(
                    "do_again.service.daemon.notify_receipt",
                    side_effect=BrowserError("project has no bound automation chat; run do-again setup"),
                ),
            ):
                with self.assertRaises(BrowserError):
                    _drain_browser_outbox_locked(repo, state_dir)

            self.assertTrue(path.exists())

''' + anchor

if "test_nontransient_browser_error_still_aborts_drain" not in t:
    t = t.replace(anchor, new_test, 1)

tests.write_text(t)

subprocess.run(["python3", "-m", "unittest", "tests.test_daemon"], check=True)
subprocess.run(["python3", "-m", "unittest", "discover", "-s", "tests", "-p", "test_*.py"], check=True)
subprocess.run(["git", "add", "src/do_again/service/daemon.py", "tests/test_daemon.py"], check=True)
subprocess.run(["git", "commit", "-m", "Skip only transient busy receipt blocks"], check=True)

push = subprocess.run(["git", "push", "origin", "main"])
if push.returncode != 0:
    subprocess.run(["git", "fetch", "origin", "main"], check=True)
    subprocess.run(["git", "rebase", "origin/main"], check=True)
    subprocess.run(["python3", "-m", "unittest", "tests.test_daemon"], check=True)
    subprocess.run(["python3", "-m", "unittest", "discover", "-s", "tests", "-p", "test_*.py"], check=True)
    subprocess.run(["git", "push", "origin", "main"], check=True)

print("HEAD=" + subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip())
print("STATUS=")
print(subprocess.check_output(["git", "status", "--short"], text=True))
